class.name: LandscapeFoliageData
class.brief_description: Instances of a [LandscapeFoliage3D], streamed from a [code].lfdata[/code] file.
class.description: Stores the instances of the foliage types of a [LandscapeFoliage3D] (one layer per type, in the same order) in square cells of [member chunk_size] meters. A [code].lfdata[/code] file holds an index (instance count and bounds of every cell) and the compressed instances of each cell: loading the file only reads the index, the cells are then loaded on demand by the node, in the background (through [WorldStreaming]), around the camera and the streaming sources. Cells edited by the node are kept in memory until the data is saved (in the editor, when the scene is saved). A data that isn't saved to a file (e.g. embedded in a scene) keeps every cell in memory. The memory used by the streamed cells is reported in the [code]Streaming/Foliage CPU[/code] monitor, the memory of [member LandscapeFoliage3D.gpu_indirect] in [code]Streaming/Foliage GPU[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] Create it with [method LandscapeFoliage3D.save_to_data_file] (or the [b]Save to File[/b] button of the Foliage tab of the Landscape dock).

method.name: get_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of cells that have instances in the layer [param layer] (all layers if negative).

method.name: get_instance_count
method.description: Returns the number of instances in the layer [param layer] (all layers if negative), loaded or not.

method.name: get_layer_count
method.description: Returns the number of layers (foliage types).

method.name: get_memory_usage
method.description: Returns the memory in bytes kept by the data: the edited cells not saved yet and the loaded cells not taken by the node yet (the cells loaded by the node are counted by [method LandscapeFoliage3D.get_statistics]).

method.name: has_unsaved_changes
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if cells were edited since the data was last saved or loaded.

method.name: is_streamed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the cells are read from a [code].lfdata[/code] file.

members.member: Size in meters of the cells. It follows [member LandscapeFoliage3D.chunk_size]: changing it sorts every instance into the new cells (they are kept in memory until the data is saved).
